description: Ministry of Citry Planning and Water Supply - Land Acquisition - Ukuwela, Ukuwela D/S Division, Matale District - Nagollagama, Matale D/S Division, Matale District - Kotandeniyawa, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land parcels) for water supply infrastructure projects. Each order includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and the names of claimants/owners. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it focuses on land acquisition, property descriptions, and real estate matters for public infrastructure projects.
